title: Expert warns of 'hotter summers, more wildfires, more drought and more floods'
summary: One of the world's leading climate scientists has spoken to FRANCE 24 about the extreme heat events of this summer, and in the wake of the catastrophic flooding in Nepal, how other similar events are all but inevitable.
